t: Snapout: Understanding Its Legal Definition in Florida | US Legal Forms

t: What is a snapout memo in sentencing on my pending felony charge? - Legal Answers
s: The "snapout" is a Court-generated document for each case on the Court's daily docket that is completed by the clerk, who sits next to the Judge. It has a LOT of blocks & lines, for the Clerk to quickly fill in what happened with respect to the case.
